title: 第十章：渴望强大的心
content_zh:
在苏晓一刀贯穿两人后，他马上发现，在欧卡头顶出现一条淡红色血条。
不用说，这一定是欧卡剩余的生命值，他这一刀贯穿欧卡的脊柱，使对方处于假死状态，并不是彻底死亡。
所谓假死，就是身体已经没有反抗能力，但大脑依然存活。
这是苏晓第一次见到血条，之前杀死黑市商人时，对方是被他一枪爆头，根本没出现血条。
血条无疑是半数据化的好处，可以让他判断敌人是否已经死亡，以及敌人大概的生命值。
现在的欧卡，生命值大概剩5%左右，已经是在催死边缘。
将长刀在欧卡后脑内抽出，苏晓单手握刀，由反手改为正手，一刀斩向欧卡的脖颈。
“噗嗤。”
鲜血喷溅起几米高，苏晓的脸颊被溅上几滴鲜血，让他看起来格外冰冷。
这一刀之后欧卡的人头飞起，血条瞬间清空。
【你杀死了侍卫首领布兰登?欧卡】
【布兰登?欧卡为哥亚王国官员，获得世界之源3.6%，现共获得世界之源5.7%。】
【你的天赋‘噬灵者’发动，永久增加10点法力值，现有法力值75点。】
接连的提示，苏晓只是大致查看一番。
杀掉欧卡居然能获得世界之源，这让苏晓有些意想不到，如果杀掉更强的敌人，获得世界之源的数量也会相应提升。
如果杀死海贼世界的海军元帅战国，或四皇红发等人，那获得世界之源数量，绝对是一个夸张的数字。
但现在也只能想想而已，苏晓根本见不到那种级别的强者，就算见到苏晓也不会动手，因为那是找死的行为。
现在世界之源的作用还不清楚，之前轮回乐园只是提示，世界之源关乎他完成任务后，离开海贼世界时的奖励。
这所谓的奖励，应该就是他变强的关键。
海贼世界的确有许多变强的方法，可都需要时间，他一共只有七十二小时，现在只剩六十多小时，在时限内能完成任务已经算万幸，苏晓根本没时间考虑其他。

至于恶魔果实这种逆天的奇物，苏晓想都没想过，没有一定实力基础，根本没资格去寻找或抢夺恶魔果实。
他只是身体素质较强的普通人，和海贼世界的强者有本质差距。
按照正常情况，苏晓的第一个世界，根本不可能是海贼王这种高危世界，这都是因为他那猎杀者的身份。
现在的情况就好像把一个1级的新手，扔进高级地图中，这地图的小怪，对于苏晓来说都是boss般的存在。
苏晓能做到现在的程度，已经是远超常人，如果换做普通契约者，有很大可能会死在王都外的废品终点站。
获得的世界之源暂且不提，而获得的法力值，更让苏晓一头雾水。
他根本没有消耗法力值的能力，就算有再多法力值也是空谈，对战斗毫无帮助。
万事开头难，还要靠自己。
欧卡的尸体上，漂浮起一个白色宝箱，宝箱与之前他开启的相同。
苏晓拿起宝箱，直接放进储物空间，之后快速离开现场。
他现在是一位侍卫，这重身份对他很重要。
而且杀死侍卫首领欧卡这件事，一旦被外人得知，他就会成为哥亚王国的逃犯。
到时不要说完成任务，躲避哥亚王国士兵的追杀就会让苏晓焦头烂额。
夜晚的凉风吹动苏晓的黑发，逐渐冲淡了他身上的血腥气。
回到白天洗澡的那间民宅前，苏晓查看了之前布下的警戒设施，一根短树枝和几根头发，没人来过，这里很安全。
进入民宅后，苏晓没开灯，而是坐在漆黑的卧室中，拿出杀死欧卡获得的宝箱。
【宝箱（白），是/否开启】
开启宝箱，一条项链直接出现在苏晓手中。
【你开启了宝箱（白），获得以下物品】
【获得300乐园币】

【获得亡妻的项坠】
亡妻的项坠（白色）
产地：海贼王，加勒特宝石公司
类别：首饰（首饰类装备为稀少物品）
耐久度：无。（首饰类装备无耐久度，无需修理）
装备需求：任何人都可穿戴。
装备效果：力量+1.
评分：8.（注：白色装备评分为1到10，评分为10的白色装备将标注‘稀有’，附加特殊属性。）
简介：我爱你，就像你爱那些小情人般――欧卡自杀的妻子。
价格：1600乐园币。
紧握着手中的项链，苏晓脸上浮现笑意。
他终于，终于找到变强的方法，手中这宝石项链居然能增加他的力量。
长舒了口气，苏晓冷静下来，把【亡妻的项坠】带在脖颈上。
再次查看个人资料，原本的6点力量，已经变成7点。
一股热流融入身体，苏晓明显的察觉到，他的力量变强了一大截。
力量提升到7点，并不是他的力量增加了六分之一，而且增长了一大截。
这就代表每提升一点属性，都会带来巨大变化，绝不是1+1那么简单。
“轮回乐园，真是神奇的地方。”
苏晓握紧拳头，骨节咔咔作响，澎湃的力量在体内奔涌。
这种突然变强的感觉，让他有些迷醉，但并不迷茫。

苏晓清楚的知道，项链提升的力量只是外在，他本身的力量并没有提升，在失去项链后，他的力量属性就会减少。
力量提升的喜悦，并没冲昏苏晓的头脑。
他马上想到，这条项坠是欧卡的物品，有可能被其他人认出，如果是那样的话，事情就麻烦了。
就在苏晓苦恼时，他突然发现视线中多出一行微小的文字，非常不易察觉。
【是/否开启隐藏装备功能，此功能需要花费100乐园币，为永久能力。】
100乐园币的购买力苏晓还不了解，但他手中的乐园币都是他拼着性命得到的，非常珍贵。
可这项功能也非常实用，苏晓果断开启。
【你开始了装备隐藏功能，可自由隐藏穿戴中的装备，武器类装备无法隐藏。】
脖颈上吊坠逐渐消失，但力量加成还在，这让苏晓十分满意，这100乐园币花的很值。
在刚进入轮回乐园时，苏晓心中有些怀疑，这未知且强大的存在，到底有什么目的。
从现在的情况来看，只要他完成任务，轮回乐园就会给予他奖励。
至于轮回乐园是否会害他，苏晓现在不太关心这个问题。
能把他必死的伤势恢复，并且传送到海贼王世界，无一不体现出轮回乐园的强大。
苏晓没有杞人忧天的习惯，如果轮回乐园想对他不利，又何必要救他？
就算是利用关系，苏晓也能从中得到好处，在现实世界永远得不到的好处，那就是变强。
或许，在他完成第一个任务后，对轮回乐园的了解就能多一些，现在变强才是关键。
弱小即是原罪，这一点苏晓深有体会，如果当初他足够强，就能避免那场惨剧的发生。
被鲜血侵染的洁白地面，支离破碎的残尸，和那……。
苏晓强行掐断回忆，一双漆黑的眸子在黑暗中圆睁。
毫无睡意的躺在床上，苏晓强迫自己休息，明天还有许多事要做，必要的休息能让他更加精力充沛。

局面已经
不仅要杀掉，还要全身而退，他只是在执行任务，而不是轮回乐园的刺客，这其中有本质区别。
刺客只是死士而已，而苏晓有明确的目标。
(三七中文 et)
content_en:
After Su Xiao penetrated the two of them with a knife, he immediately noticed that a light red blood bar appeared above Oka's head.
Needless to say, this must be Ouka's remaining health. His knife penetrated Ouka's spine, causing the opponent to be in a state of suspended animation, not a complete death.
The so-called suspended animation means that the body has no ability to resist, but the brain is still alive.
This was the first time Su Xiao saw a health bar. When he killed a black market businessman before, he shot him in the head and there was no health bar at all.
The health bar is undoubtedly a semi-digital benefit, allowing him to determine whether the enemy is dead and the approximate health value of the enemy.
Oka's current health value is about 5%, and he is already on the verge of death.
Pulling out the long knife from the back of Ouka's head, Su Xiao held the knife with one hand, changed from backhand to forehand, and slashed towards Ouka's neck.
"Pfft."
Blood sprayed several meters high, and Su Xiao's cheek was splashed with a few drops of blood, making him look particularly cold.
After this blow, Oka's head flew up, and his health bar was instantly cleared.
[You killed the guard leader Brandon Oka]
[Brandon Oka is an official of the Kingdom of Goa and has received 3.6% of the Source of the World. Now he has received a total of 5.7% of the Source of the World. 】
[Your talent ‘Soul Eater’ is activated, permanently increasing the mana value by 10 points, and the current mana value is 75 points. 】
After prompting one after another, Su Xiao just took a general look.
Killing Ouka can actually get the Source of the World, which makes Su Xiao a little unexpected. If you kill stronger enemies, the amount of the Source of the World will increase accordingly.
If you kill the Admiral Sengoku of the Pirate World, or the Four Emperors Red Hair and others, the number of World Sources obtained is definitely an exaggerated number.
But now I can only think about it. Su Xiao will never see a strong man of that level. Even if he sees Su Xiao, he will not do anything because it is an act of seeking death.
The role of the Source of the World is still unclear. Previously, Samsara Paradise was just a reminder that the Source of the World is related to the reward when he leaves the pirate world after completing the mission.
This so-called reward should be the key to him becoming stronger.
There are indeed many ways to become stronger in the pirate world, but they all take time. He only has seventy-two hours in total, and now he only has more than sixty hours left. He is lucky to be able to complete the task within the time limit. Su Xiao has no time to think about anything else.
As for Devil Fruit, a magical thing that defies the heavens, Su Xiao has never thought about it. Without a certain strength foundation, he is not qualified to find or snatch Devil Fruit.
He is just an ordinary person with strong physical fitness, and there is an essential gap between him and the strong men in the pirate world.
Under normal circumstances, Su Xiao's first world could not be a high-risk world like One Piece, all because of his status as a hunter.
The current situation is like throwing a level 1 novice into an advanced map. The mobs on this map are all boss-like existences to Su Xiao.
What Su Xiao can achieve now is far beyond ordinary people. If he were an ordinary contractor, he would most likely die at the scrap terminal outside the royal capital.
Not to mention the source of the world obtained, but the mana obtained made Su Xiao even more confused.
He has no ability to consume mana at all. Even if he has more mana, it is empty talk and will not help the battle.
Everything is difficult at the beginning, you have to rely on yourself.
On Oka's body, a white treasure box floated, which was the same as the one he opened before.
Su Xiao picked up the treasure box, put it directly into the storage space, and then quickly left the scene.
He is now a guard, and this identity is very important to him.
Moreover, once outsiders learn about the killing of the guard leader Oka, he will become a fugitive from the Kingdom of Goa.
Not to mention completing the mission by then, Su Xiao would be very anxious to avoid the pursuit of Goa Kingdom soldiers.
The cool breeze at night blew Su Xiao's black hair, gradually diluting the bloody smell on his body.
Returning to the house where he took a bath during the day, Su XiaochaAfter looking at the warning facilities set up before, a short branch and a few hairs, no one has been here, it is safe here.
After entering the house, Su Xiao did not turn on the lights, but sat in the dark bedroom and took out the treasure box obtained by killing Oka.
[Treasure chest (white), yes/no to open]
Opening the treasure chest, a necklace appeared directly in Su Xiao's hand.
[You opened the treasure chest (white) and obtained the following items]
【Obtain 300 Paradise Coins】
[Obtain the pendant from his deceased wife]
Dead Wife's Pendant (White)
Origin: One Piece, Garrett Gem Company
Category: Jewelry (Jewelry equipment is a rare item)
Durability: None. (Jewelry equipment has no durability and does not need to be repaired)
Equipment Requirements: Wearable by anyone.
Equipment effect: Strength +1.
Rating: 8. (Note: The rating of white equipment is from 1 to 10. White equipment with a rating of 10 will be marked 'rare' and have special attributes attached.)
Introduction: I love you, just like you love those little lovers - Oka's wife who committed suicide.
Price: 1,600 paradise coins.
Holding the necklace in her hand tightly, a smile appeared on Lidya Su's face.
He finally found a way to become stronger. The gem necklace in his hand could actually increase his strength.
Taking a long breath, Su Xiao calmed down and put the [Dead Wife's Pendant] around her neck.
Checking the personal information again, the original 6 points of strength have become 7 points.
A stream of heat flowed into his body, and Su Xiao clearly noticed that his strength had become much stronger.
The increase in strength to 7 points did not mean that his strength increased by one-sixth, but by a large amount.
This means that every improvement in attributes will bring about huge changes, and it is by no means as simple as 1+1.
"Reincarnation Paradise is such a magical place."
Su Xiao clenched her fists, her joints crackling, and surging power surged through her body.
This sudden feeling of strength made him a little intoxicated, but not confused.
Su Xiao knew clearly that the power enhanced by the necklace was only external, and his own power had not been improved. After losing the necklace, his power attributes would be reduced.
The joy of increasing strength did not go to Su Xiao's mind.
He immediately thought that this necklace was Ouka's item and might be recognized by others. If that was the case, things would be in trouble.
Just when Su Xiao was distressed, he suddenly found an extra line of tiny text in his sight, which was very difficult to detect.
[Yes/No to enable the hidden equipment function. This function requires 100 paradise coins and is a permanent ability. 】
Su Xiao didn't understand the purchasing power of 100 paradise coins yet, but the paradise coins in his hand were obtained by him at the risk of his life, and they were very precious.
But this function is also very practical, so Su Xiao decisively turns it on.
[You have started the equipment hiding function. You can freely hide the equipment you are wearing. Weapons and equipment cannot be hidden. 】
The pendant around his neck gradually disappeared, but the strength bonus was still there, which made Su Xiao very satisfied. The 100 paradise coins were well spent.
When he first entered the Reincarnation Paradise, Su Xiao had some doubts about the purpose of this unknown and powerful existence.
Judging from the current situation, as long as he completes the task, Samsara Paradise will reward him.
As for whether the reincarnation paradise will harm him, Su Xiao is not too concerned about this issue now.
Being able to recover his fatal injuries and transport him to the world of One Piece all reflects the power of Samsara Paradise.
Su Xiao doesn't have the habit of worrying about things. If Samsara Paradise wants to harm him, why bother to save him?
Even if he uses relationships, Su Xiao can get benefits from them. The benefits that he will never get in the real world are to become stronger.
Perhaps, after he completes the first mission, he will know more about Samsara Paradise. Getting stronger now is the key.
Weakness is the original sin. Su Xiao knows this very well. If he had been strong enough, he could have avoided that tragedy.
The white ground stained with blood supportsThe broken corpses, and that...
Su Xiao forcibly cut off the memories, and a pair of dark eyes widened in the darkness.
Lying in bed without sleep, Su Xiao forced himself to rest. There were still many things to do tomorrow, and the necessary rest would make him more energetic.
The situation has
He not only wanted to kill, but also escaped intact. He was just performing a mission, not an assassin in Samsara Paradise. There was an essential difference.
Assassins are just dead soldiers, but Su Xiao has a clear goal.
(Sanqi Chinese et)
